annotations.title: Meta reach and frequency predictions and reservations

description: Reach and frequency buying on Meta. action list (default) / get (predictionId). predict: a QUOTE, nothing is bought: startDate, endDate (at most 8 weeks ahead, ending at midnight or after 06:00 account time) and exactly one of budgetAmount (Meta predicts reach) or reach (Meta predicts the budget); optional frequencyCap, targeting (one country), pageId, objective. reserve locks the quoted price and inventory and returns a NEW prediction id for the campaign; cancel releases a reservation. reserve and cancel need confirm:true after the user agrees. Free.

action.description: list (default), predict, get, reserve or cancel

adAccountId.description: Meta ad account id (act_123 or the bare number); it must be one this brand has shared

budgetAmount.description: lifetime budget in the account currency

confirm.description: true after the user agreed (reserve, cancel)

intervalFrequencyCapResetPeriod.description: hours (multiple of 24) the cap resets over
